lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: So, Macal. We love the portfolio. But tell me — why should we pick you over the other finalists?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Honestly? Because I'm not gonna pretend to be someone else. I know my English isn't perfect, but my work speaks louder than my accent.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Interesting. And if we offered you the role today — what would you say?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I'd say thank you. Then I'd ask what you're offering — because I've got two worlds counting on this answer.
lines.direction: firm, a small smile in his voice

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا يَا جَمَاعَة! أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَمَعَاكُم فِي يَالّا فْلُوِنْت...

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: النَّهَارْدَه يَوْمْ كَبِيرْ فِي حَيَاةْ مَكَال... يَوْمْ الإِنْتَرْفْيُو الأَخِيرْ فِي دُونْ أَنْدْ كُو، وَقَرَارْ كَبِيرْ عَلَى المَحَكْ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: اسْمَعُوا كُوَيِّسْ لِتَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَاتْ: "my work speaks louder than my accent"، وَ"what you're offering"، وَ"I intend to"...

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: دُولْ مِفْتَاحْ كَلَامْ النَّهَارْدَه! يَالّا نِسْمَعْ مَكَالْ بِيِتَفَاوَضْ وَبِيِخْتَارْ مُسْتَقْبَلُه... يَالّا!

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Let's be direct, Macal. Tarek has an MBA and ten years at a top firm. You have three years and a lot of heart. Convince me that's enough.
lines.direction: calm, probing, slight Indian accent, measured

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I can't compete with his resume, and I'm not gonna try. What I can tell you is this — I live here since two years, and in that time I've shipped every project on that table. Nobody had to teach me twice.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: That's a fair point. But heart doesn't always survive deadlines. What happens when it gets hard?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: It already got hard. Three months ago I almost lost this chance. I stayed, I learned, I showed up. That's the proof you're asking for — not a diploma, a track record.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Alright. So if we move forward — what are you looking for, exactly?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Before I answer that, I wanna thank you for this process. It's been honest, and that means something. Now — what you're offering matters more than what I'm asking. So tell me the number, the title, and the growth path. Then I'll tell you if I can say yes.
lines.direction: calm, respectful, negotiating with quiet authority

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Fifteen percent above your current salary. Senior associate. And a mentorship track with the design lead.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: That's solid. One thing — I intend to keep building Macal Empire on the side. It doesn't compete with Dune, it feeds it. If that's a problem, we should talk about it now, not later.
lines.direction: firm but warm, laying cards on the table

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Honestly? That's the first honest answer I've heard all week. Let me make a call. Give me ten minutes.
lines.direction: slight smile, decisive, rising to leave

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Take your time. I'll be right here, breathing.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّبْ... خُدْ بَالَكْ مِنْ تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَاتْ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَوَّلْ وَاحِدْ، لَمَّا تِقُولْ: my work speaks louder than my accent... يَعْنِي شُغْلِي بِيِتَكَلَّمْ عَنِّي، أَكْتَرْ مِنْ لَهْجَتِي. تِسْتَعْمِلْهَا لَمَّا حَدْ يِشَكِّكْ فِي قُدْرَتِكْ بِسَبَبْ الإِنْجْلِيزِي. مِثَالْ: I may not sound perfect, but my work speaks louder than my accent.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَانِي وَاحِدْ: What you're offering... يَعْنِي إِنْتَ بِتَعْرِضْ إِيهْ بِالظَّبْطْ؟ دِي طَرِيقَةْ مُؤَدَّبَةْ إِنَّكْ تِسْأَلْ عَنْ الرَّقَمْ وَاللَّقَبْ، بَدَلْ مَا تِقُولْ: how much? مِثَالْ: Before I decide, tell me what you're offering.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَالِتْ وَاحِدْ: I intend to... يَعْنِي نَاوِي أَعْمَلْ إِيهْ. دِي أَقْوَى مِنْ I want، لِأَنَّهَا بْتُوضِّحْ نِيَّةْ وَخُطَّةْ. مِثَالْ: I intend to keep learning every single day.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: غَلْطَةْ شَائِعَةْ: مَكَالْ قَالْ: I live here since two years. لِيهْ؟ لِأَنَّ فِي العَرَبِي بِنْقُولْ: أَنَا عَايِشْ هِنَا مِنْ سَنِتَيْن، فَبِنْقَلِّدْهَا زِي مَا هِي. الصَّحْ: I've lived here for two years. الـ since مَعَ نُقْطَةْ بِدَايَةْ... وَالـ for مَعَ مُدَّةْ زَمَنْ.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَالّا بَقَى مَعَ الـ Accent Lab! خُدْ كَلْمَةْ track record... الإِنْجْلِيزِي بِيِقُولْهَا: track record، وَالـ T وَالـ R مَلْزُوقِينْ. مِشْ track... record. كَرَّرْ وَرَايَا: track record.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَكَلْمَةْ تَانْيَةْ: what you're offering... لَمَّا بْتِتْكَلَّمْ بِسُرْعَةْ، الـ t بْتِبْقَى زِي d خَفِيفَةْ: what you're offering... رَبْطْ نَاعِمْ، مِشْ what you are offering. كَرِّرْ: what you're offering. عَاشْ! كِدَا بِقِيتْ أَمْرِيكِي!

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Alright, Macal. I made the call. The answer is yes — senior associate, fifteen percent, and the mentorship track. But I have one condition.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Name it. I've lived here for two years now, so I've learned to listen before I react.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Keep Macal Empire alive. Honestly, that side project is the reason I'm signing you. Just don't let it eat your mornings.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Deal. And thank you — for being straight with me from the first question. That's rarer than a good salary.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: So? Don't make me guess — I've been standing in that hallway pretending to read a menu for twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I got it. Senior associate. And listen — I intend to keep building my studio, and they actually want that.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Macal. That's huge. I'm staying in Dubai — if you want me to. I mean, for the studio. If you're building something real.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Congratulations. I mean it. Look — I've been thinking. What if we co-build a learning studio? Your voice, my structure. Two worlds, one table.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Two worlds, one table. I like that. But first — I need a minute. My phone's been buzzing all morning.

lines.speaker: Friend_F
lines.text: Macal? I'm calling from Cairo. A learner heard your story on the podcast and she wants to know — can she really start from zero?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَالّا نِلَخَّصْ بِسُرْعَةْ... الْيَوْمْ بِنْقُولْ: my work speaks louder than my accent، و what you're offering، و I intend to. وَالْجُمْلَةْ الْأَهَمْ... I've lived here for two years، بِـ for مَعَ الْمُدَّةْ، مِشْ since.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَةْ الْحَلْقَةْ... هِيَّ: what you're offering. لِأَنَّهَا بْتُفْتَحْ بِهَا أَيِّ مُفَاوَضَةْ، بِأَدَبْ وَثِقَةْ، مِنْ غِيرْ مَا تِقُولْ how much!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: دَلْوَقْتِي دَوْرَكْ إِنْتَ... سَجِّلْ ڤُويْسْ نُوتْ صُغَيَّرْ، قُولْ فِيهْ بِصُوتْ عَالِي: what you're offering، وَخُدْ بَالَكْ مِنْ الرَّبْطْ النَّاعِمْ... رَكِّزْ عَلَى الصَّوْتْ.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَابْعَتَهَا عَلَى تِيلِيجْرَامْ فِي مَجْمُوعَةْ Empire English Community... إِحْنَا مِسْتَحْكِمِينْ، بِنِسْمَعْ لَهْجَتَكْ، وَنِشَجَّعَكْ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: مِتْخَافْشْ مِنْ الْأَكْسِنْتْ... إِنْتَ مِشْ بِتِتْحَنِّمْ، إِنْتَ بِتِتْكَلَّمْ. يَالّا وَرَّنَا صَوْتَكْ، وَنِشُوفْ حَلْقَةْ الْجَايْ!

phonetic_focus.note: Put it all together - stress, flap-T, TH, linking, schwa, intonation - in one flowing, confident, natural American delivery.
